metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in Taipei,Taiwan decrease in January 17-24, 2016 compared to the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Does the land surface temperature in Taipei,Taiwan decrease in January 17-24, 2016 compared to the 2001-2010 average for the same period?" Interpretation: - Need to compare LST in Jan 17-24, 2016 vs the average of Jan 17-24 over 2001-2010. - Location: Taipei, Taiwan (25.0330° N, 121.5654° E). We'll use a point or small buffer. - Data: MODIS LST (MOD11A1 or MOD11A2) is suitable. It provides daily/8-day LST at 1km. - Time: Jan 17-24 each year (8-day period). MOD11A2 gives 8-day composites; the period Jan 17-24 corresponds to DOY 017-024 (8-day composite starting Jan 17). So we can use MOD11A2 (8-day) for consistency. - We need to compute: - For 2001-2010: For each year, get LST for Jan 17-24 period, take mean over those years. - For 2016: Get LST for Jan 17-24 period. - Compare: if LST_2016 < LST_avg_2001_2010, then answer Yes (A), else No (B). Data Quality & Logic: - Use MOD11A2 (8-day LST) collection: 'MODIS/006/MOD11A2'. - Band: 'LST_Day_1km' (daytime LST) or 'LST_Night_1km'. The question says "land surface temperature" without specifying day/night; we'll use daytime. - Scale: LST in Kelvin, multiply by 0.02 to get Kelvin, then convert to Celsius: K * 0.02 - 273.15. - Mask clouds: Use QC band 'QC_Day' to mask low quality. According to MODIS LST QC: bits 0-1: Mandatory QA flags (00=good, 01=ok, 10=cloud, 11=other). We'll keep only 00 and 01. - Geometry: Taipei point buffered by 10km. - Check collection size for each period. If no images, try fallback? The period is fixed; if MOD11A2 fails, could try MOD11A1 (daily) but then need to composite. Let's try MOD11A2 first. - Compute mean LST over region for each period. - Validate: LST in Celsius should be reasonable (-50 to 50°C). If outside, maybe error. Steps: 1. Define geometry (Taipei point buffer). 2. Define time ranges: - Historical: for each year 2001-2010, filter collection for Jan 17-24 (using day-of-year). Then combine images across years, compute mean. - 2016: filter for Jan 17-24, 2016. 3. Check collection sizes. 4. Process each image: apply scaling, mask using QC. 5. Compute mean LST over region for historical and 2016. 6. Compare. Fallback: If MOD11A2 has no data, we could try MOD11A1 (daily) and composite within the date range. But let's try MOD11A2 first. Output: Print counts, mean temperatures, then final answer. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry: Taipei, Taiwan var taipei = ee.Geometry.Point(121.5654, 25.0330).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer // 2. Data: MODIS 8-day LST (MOD11A2) var modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A2'); // Function to process LST image: scale, mask using QC function processLST(img) { var lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // to Celsius var qc = img.select('QC_Day'); // Bits 0-1: 00=good, 01=ok, 10=cloud, 11=other. Keep 00 and 01. var mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // values 0 or 1 return lst.updateMask(mask).rename('LST'); } // 3. Historical: Jan 17-24 for each year 2001-2010 var historicalYears = ee.List.sequence(2001, 2010); var historicalCollection = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages( historicalYears.map(function(year) { var start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 17); var end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 25); // exclusive return modis.filterDate(start, end) .map(processLST) .mean() .set('year', year); }) ); // 4. 2016: Jan 17-24 var start2016 = ee.Date.fromYMD(2016, 1, 17); var end2016 = ee.Date.fromYMD(2016, 1, 25); var collection2016 = modis.filterDate(start2016, end2016).map(processLST); // Check sizes var histSize = historicalCollection.size().getInfo(); var size2016 = collection2016.size().getInfo(); print('Historical images (years with data):', histSize); print('2016 images:', size2016); // If no data, try fallback to daily MOD11A1 if (histSize === 0 || size2016 === 0) { print('Trying MOD11A1 (daily) as fallback...'); var modisDaily = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1'); // Reprocess for daily: same processing, but need to composite over date range function processDaily(img) { var lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); var qc = img.select('QC_Day'); var mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); return lst.updateMask(mask).rename('LST'); } // Historical: for each year, filter date range and composite historicalCollection = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages( historicalYears.map(function(year) { var start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 17); var end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 25); return modisDaily.filterDate(start, end) .map(processDaily) .mean() .set('year', year); }) ); collection2016 = modisDaily.filterDate(start2016, end2016).map(processDaily); histSize = historicalCollection.size().getInfo(); size2016 = collection2016.size().getInfo(); print('After fallback - Historical images:', histSize); print('After fallback - 2016 images:', size2016); } // If still no data, output C1 if (histSize === 0 || size2016 === 0) { print('C1'); return; } // Compute mean LST images over each collection var histMean = historicalCollection.mean(); var img2016 = collection2016.mean(); // Compute region statistics: mean temperature and pixel count var histStats = histMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: taipei, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); var histLST = histStats['LST']; var histCount = histStats['LST_count']; var stats2016 = img2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: taipei, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); var lst2016 = stats2016['LST']; var count2016 = stats2016['LST_count']; print('Historical (2001-2010 avg) LST (°C):', histLST, 'Valid pixels:', histCount); print('2016 LST (°C):', lst2016, 'Valid pixels:', count2016); // Check for no valid pixels if (histCount === 0 || count2016 === 0) { print('C2'); return; } // Validate LST values (reasonable range for Taipei in January: maybe -10 to 30°C) if (histLST === null || lst2016 === null || histLST < -50 || histLST > 50 || lst2016 < -50 || lst2016 > 50) { print('C3'); return; } // Compare: if 2016 temperature is lower (decrease) if (lst2016 < histLST) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
